units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 8:1">Shebu. VIII, 1</cite>, a. e. <he>נושא ש׳</he> he that receives wages (for watching), v. <cite ref="U00454"><he>שׁוֹמֵר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 112a:2">B. Mets. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הכובש שְׂ׳ וכ׳</he> he that delays the payment of the hired man’s wages, is considered as if taking his life.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:11">Ab. V, 11</cite> <he>יצא שְׂכָרוֹ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00752"><he>הֶפְסֵד</he></cite>.
B. Kam. 116ᵃ, a. e. אין לו אלא שְׂכָרוֹ he can claim only the ordinary laborer’s pay, v. שָׁלֵם II; a. fr.—Esp. divine reward.

<cite ref="Eruvin 22a:5">Erub. 22ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:11">Deut. VII, 11</cite>) <he>היום לעשותם … למחר לקכל שְׂכָרָם</he> ‘to do them to-day’, and not to do them to-morrow (do not procrastinate); ‘to do them to-day’, and to receive the reward for them tomorrow (expect not immediate reward). Ib. 65ᵃ <he>לא נכרא יין … לשלם ש׳ לרשעים</he> wine has been created for the purpose of comforting (cheering up) mourners and paying reward to the wicked (for what good they may do, in this world); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Num. R. s. 10<sup>4</sup></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:16">Ab. II, 16</cite> <he>נאמן … שְׂכַר פעולתך</he> thy employer may be trusted that he will pay thee the wages due for thy work.
Ib. ודע שמתן שְׂכָרָם וכ׳ but keep in mind that the reward of the righteous is reserved for the hereafter; a. fr.—בִּשְׂכַר as a reward for, on account of (cmp. זְבוּת).

<cite ref="Sotah 11b:4">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>בש׳ נשים צדקניות וכ׳</he> for the sake of the righteous women of that generation were the Israelites redeemed; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:25">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 88b:12">Ḥull. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>בש׳ שאמר וכ׳</he> as a reward for what Abraham our father said (<cite ref="Genesis 18:27">Gen. XVIII, 27</cite>) &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45:6">Ex. R. s. 45</cite> <he>בש׳ שלש זכה לשלש</he> on account of three things he (Moses) was granted three things; <he>בש׳ ויסתר וכ׳</he> on account of ‘he hid his face’ (<cite ref="Exodus 3:6">Ex. III, 6</cite>) &c.; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 371">Yalk. Is. 371</cite> <he>שכרן</he>, read: <he>שִׂבְרָן</he>, v. <cite ref="O00089"><he>סֵבֶר</he></cite>.]
